shellCommands.command: cat /workspace/node_modules/react/package.json | grep '"version"'; echo "---"; grep -r "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js | head -5; echo "---link---"; grep -n "transitionTypes" -r /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/link.js /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rn "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/react/cjs/*.js | head -20; echo "---"; find /workspace/node_modules/next -path "*vendored*react*" -maxdepth 5 -type d 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---check exports---"; node -e "const r = require('/workspace/node_modules/react'); console.log(Object.keys(r).filter(k=>k.toLowerCase().includes('transition')))"

find /workspace/node_modules/react -name "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -l "ViewTransition" 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; cat /workspace/node_modules/react/package.json | grep -A2 '"types"'; echo "---tsconfig---"; cat /workspace/tsconfig.json
nohup npx next dev -p 3311 > /tmp/nextdev.log 2>&1 & echo "started pid $!"; sleep 3; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3311/
ls /workspace/node_modules/.bin/ | grep -iE "playwright|puppeteer|chrome" ; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; npm ls playwright puppeteer 2>&1 | head -5

curl -s http://localhost:3311/ | grep -o "product-image[^\"]*" | head -5
echo "---detail---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3311/product/classic-sneakers
curl -s http://localhost:3311/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o "product-hero[^\"]*\|product-info" | head -5
echo "---logs---"
cat /tmp/nextdev.log
